summary: Implementation plan for expanding OpenUPI Gateway into a comprehensive, modern self-hosted UPI checkout platform featuring all 9 core modules: Universal JavaScript SDK (openupi.js), Dynamic QR engine with intent generation, database-backed Payment Queue with live concurrency limits, Merchant & Customer Phone Verification Auth, Android Companion architecture & telemetry prober, Cash-on-Delivery (COD) lifecycle management, Offline POS cashier counter, White-label visual engine, and a complete Developer Experience suite with interactive API playground and test suite.
